Copier Rental Ortigas Shared-Service Checklist

A support article for Ortigas shared-service copier planning

Use this checklist with Copier Rental Ortigas when one copier will support multiple teams, departments, or floors across Ortigas Center.

Clarify user demand first

  • Estimate daily users, monthly copy volume, and peak document periods.
  • List scan-to-email, shared-folder, duplex, and paper-size requirements.
  • Decide whether one central copier can replace multiple smaller devices.
  • Compare against Printer Rental Ortigas if the workload is still printer-first.

Clarify support scope next

  • Ask whether toner, service calls, training, and replacement planning are included.
  • Confirm how tower access and freight-elevator rules affect setup timing.
  • Compare Copier Rental Pasig if the user base extends outside Ortigas Center.
  • Send the final user count and monthly volume through the contact page once the checklist is complete.
